title: Competitive Programming
highlights: My journey in Competitive Programming is the foundation of my Computer Science learning.
Started problem solving on Codeforces using C, became Specialist in 2 months, then learned C++.
Explored other platforms: HackerRank, HackerEarth, LeetCode, CodeChef, AtCoder; participated in contests.
After solving 900+ problems and 50+ contests, became Expert on Codeforces.
Participated in IUPC and ICPC contests (2021-2023 Dhaka Regional) and BUET IUPCs.
Balancing Competitive Programming with academics is challenging, but I plan to return.

title: Game Development

Shifted to game engines: Unity & Unreal (3D) tried; preferred Godot for 2D; used GDScript.
